senses.definition: vb. suffice (NH סָפַק suffice, abound, so Ecclus 15:18 +; 𝔗 סְפֵיק, סְפַק, Syriac ܣܦܰܩ; Arabic شَفِقَ is be niggardly, scanty, Lane1573);—
Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׂפֹּק 1 K 20:10, subj. dust, c. לְ rei.
